bead.title: bench-pr-A4: concurrency groups, signal handling, budget cap
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Concurrent sweeps must not stampede a shared model server; Ctrl-C/SIGTERM must leave clean, attributable state and stop containers; runs must honor a USD cap and halt before overspending.

ROOT CAUSE: concurrency, signal cleanup, and cost accounting are Go-internal in cmd/bench/matrix.go (e.g., the per-cell context timeout at cmd/bench/matrix.go:1107) with no shell equivalent; the bash runner must reimplement them on top of the A3 execution loop.

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark run mode):
- Concurrency: flock per concurrency-group at ${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/fizeau-benchmark}/locks/<group>.lock; setsid for each cell process group; background-job pool capped by --jobs. Concurrent-cells state at ${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}/<hostname>/in-flight.json: append the cell under flock at start, read current count, write count into the cell, remove at close, prune stale (dead-PID) entries on next read.
- Signals: trap SIGINT/SIGTERM -> stop accepting new cells; SIGTERM each in-flight cell process group and docker stop each in-flight harbor-runner container; wait 30s then SIGKILL; write final_status=interrupted (process_outcome=killed, no metrics) to in-flight cells; exit non-zero.
- Budget: compute cost_usd_at_run_time per cell from profile.pricing x token streams at close; accumulate into <out>/budget.json; halt before the next cell when the cap is hit; skipped cells get a final_status=budget_halted placeholder (process_outcome=setup_failed) plus a 'note' field (write_budget_halted_cell already drafted in scripts/benchmark/benchmark).

NON-SCOPE: dispatch/listing/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); execution loop/resume/retry/report compose (A3); adapters/image/runtime-probe (A1); Go changes/parity/deactivation (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: depends on A3 (the execution loop is what gets parallelized, interrupted, and costed). Parent fizeau-163efede. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary --max-cost-usd 0.01 produces at least one cell with final_status=budget_halted. (parent AC3) Test: Test_BudgetHalts (scripts/benchmark/test_budget.bash).
2. SIGTERM to a mid-sweep run marks in-flight cells final_status=interrupted, docker stops each harbor-runner container, and the runner exits non-zero. Verify: ./benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary & sleep 5; kill -TERM $!; wait; jq .final_status bench/results/.../report.json. (parent AC5) Test: Test_SigtermInterrupts (scripts/benchmark/test_sweep_shutdown.bash).
3. Two concurrent runs in the same concurrency-group serialize via flock; in-flight.json count is accurate and prunes dead PIDs. Test: Test_ConcurrencyFlock (scripts/benchmark/test_concurrency_and_signals.bash).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: Concurrency/signal/budget ACs 1-3 pass, including parent AC3 (budget_halted) and AC5 (SIGTERM cleanup); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
